access_note: Native metadata explicitly states no restriction on public access. Reuse terms are recorded separately; metadata access does not certify download availability or file-use charges. Products are not for navigation. Grid descriptions and declared format labels disagree in places.
description: The Italian Department of Civil Protection and CNR-IGAG publish the MaGIC products for sheet 29, Vulcano Palinuro. The existing collection contains eight component publications: 10 m and 50 m bathymetric contour intervals, physiographic domains, the levels 2/3/4 map, 50 m, 100 m and 200 m grids, and shaded bathymetry. The original grouping ledger proves all eight were already represented, including two omitted from the shortened access list. This correction adds direct native metadata and replaces the former generic hosting-company description. Coverage is the Vulcano Palinuro seafloor area in the southern Tyrrhenian Sea. These complementary representations overlap; they are not eight separate survey areas. The source identifies possible geological damage to people or infrastructure but supplies neither event probabilities nor engineering design loads. Metadata lists TIFF, Shapefile and GeoJSON, while grid abstracts describe x-y-z text; the file-format discrepancy remains explicit. All eight reviewed native metadata records specify CC BY 4.0 and unrestricted public access. Metadata dates are in June 2016; underlying survey dates and file-use charges are not established. These maps are not for navigation and provide no marine/coastal infrastructure inventory. The maps can inform hazard exposure simulations for marine infrastructure. No dataset or repository body was read. Other MaGIC sheets remain in the related broader record.
